d:
Hello, Shiranui Mama fans!
I have collected all of Mizuki Shiranui’s artwork that I could find, including every event CG and character tachie from Taimanin RPGX, Taimanin Arena, and Taimanin Yukikaze.
Since I do not play Action Taimanin and there are no comprehensive galleries available, I only collected several CGs and tachie from EH Gallery and game wikis. If you have more resources, please let me know.
Also included are Shiranui’s SP from the Taimanin Yukikaze OVA, Shiranui’s own OVA, and two special animated scenes from Otogi Frontier in .gif format. I have also added all the goods covers from the official webstore that do not duplicate any existing artwork.
Anyway, please enjoy!
